lines.en: On the other end of the room, which was more accurately the center of the room, which was more accurately the center of the world right now, something was happening.
A girl who had spent most of the day alone after dropping pipe bombs all over every bridge she could find was calling a girl she was genuinely worried about.

Knowing that Nodoka Nagasawa had more than just a few screws loose, Otoha Okakura was presently afraid that her head might have fallen off of her shoulders and been picked up by a horny straggler somewhere.
And while the two of them had made promises in the past to never bother one another, Otoha had a built track record of intentionally breaking promises, so that didn’t really matter to her right now.
All that really mattered was checking on her friend and making sure she wasn’t about to jump off of a roof.
And she wasn’t!
But that guess wasn’t too far off.
: It’s here, it’s here, it must be here. That’s what the letter said. Which polyrhythmic arbiter paints pickled plums in red?

Nodoka Nagasawa hated poetry just like she hated the sound of chalk on a chalkboard. She reveled in the nails instead — that familiar screech that brought her back to now sepia-tinted days full of spoons.
She was currently (but not blissfully) unaware that someone was trying to get in contact with her. Just like she had been unaware on her walk to the highest place in Kumon-mi.
If this even was the highest. If anyone even was trying to contact her. If this even was Nodoka Nagasawa and not a different girl wearing her clothes.
With each step, she comes closer to an inconvenient truth — one that she was not built to house as there were houses built for her.
No. That wasn’t right. They weren’t for her. But they could be shared with her under the right pretext.
Somehow, some way, she would set foot inside this metaphor dressed as a simile — personifying its intangibility through unconventional means like dream sequences and unintelligible anecdotes.
But before that, she had things she needed to learn. She had truths she needed to pluck from the dirt before acting as a mother bird to a mother-bird.
Yet she’d rather smother birds because other words pushed her so far in the opposite direction of her predecessor that she’d sidelined one story and wound up in another.
As the light of last summer shone down on an upside down house, she questioned whether her feet kissed the floor or the ceiling. That’s the funny thing about roofs, you see.
They’re two things at the same time, serving different purposes for different people.
That’s what Nodoka Nagasawa was here to do as well. It wasn’t enough to just choose one anymore. She cared too much now. If she didn’t, she wouldn’t be here. Right?
No one person can be that curious, don’t you think? That makes me curious, though.
I wonder what face she’ll make when she realizes her fountain pen has run out of ink.
Perhaps there is more in a well somewhere.
To Otoha again.
: What?!
To both of them this time — two sides of one coin, just one of them was blank and the other was rusted.
: I’m doing great. And you?
: Do you have any idea how much of a thorn in my paw you’ve been today?! I’d be better off letting you infect me and amputating myself at this point!
: Yeah, I love you too. I’m really happy to hear you finally admit it.
: What the fuck do you want?! I’m busy trying to save your fucking life!
: That’s gonna be hard to do with you...wherever the fuck you are right now as you’re most definitely not with me.
: I’m at school! I’m learning! That’s what people do here, motherfucker! Now either come here and help or delete my number!
: What do you mean you’re “at school?” School ended hours ago. I thought you were in your room?
: Yes! And then I figured something out because my worthless but extremely hot roommate stopped pestering me for the sole purpose of making it seem like she isn’t feeling utterly alone!
: Damn, yo. You’re just gonna call me out like that?
: That’s right. Now go lure some other unsuspecting lesbian into a relationship and leave me out of it. At least emotionally. I can fuck you when I get home tonight. Just keep your mouth shut.
: Why are you really at school, Nodoka? What are you planning on doing there? Because every time you wander off in the middle of these episodes-
: They aren’t “episodes!” They’re moments of heightened brilliance! I’m transcending! I can see everything, damn it! Don’t call me insane just because everyone else is blind!
: Well then...what do you see this time?
: Nothing yet because you can’t listen to fucking directions. I think...something is going to happen, though.
: Something as in...what exactly?
: I’m still working on that part. All I know is I told myself to come here, I’m just not sure when.
: Does alternate timeline Nodoka not believe in dating her notes or something?
: Give me a fucking break. If this was as simple as reading my own notes I wouldn’t be five minutes away from throwing myself off of the fucking roof.
: There’s a code. One that I’ve figured out because I’m a fucking genius. And also probably because it was me who made it. But even finding where I hid them is-
: Yeah, yeah. Outside the barrier, right?
: Do not mock me, whore! Just because I can reach places you can’t even comprehend does not mean those places do not exist!
: And also, please allow me to add that I do date my notes, BUT THAT DOESN’T FUCKING MATTER WHEN THE DATE IS THE SAME AS TODAY!
: Listen, Nodoka...I’m glad that you’re not getting those headaches anymore, but if you’re going to keep putting yourself in danger like this, maybe you should...you know...see someone.
: I’m already seeing Akira. And I’m pretty sure his precum contains some sort of divine aphrodisiac as he gets me even wetter than you’d be during recess at an elementary school for boys.
: I meant a doctor, idiot. Because I’m all about letting you “do your thing,” but not if it means hearing you’re five minutes away from “throwing yourself off the fucking roof.”
: Like, you’d come after me if I started writing music while tightrope walking, wouldn’t you?
: No. That would be fucking awesome. And even if it wasn’t, you can die for all I care. Maybe then I’d be able to get some peace and fucking quiet.
: You don’t mean that, Nodoka. Just...go home, okay? You need some sleep. You’ll think better in the morning.
: I don’t have until the morning! When I said that something is going to happen, I meant something is going to happen tonight! Something I need to get to the bottom of before I fucking forget!
: Nodoka...
: Don’t “Nodoka” me you angel-voiced idol fucker! You haven’t the faintest idea how many of times I’ve done this and failed! And neither do I! That’s the whole fucking point!
: Then why keep trying?! It’s driving you insane! And no one has any idea what you’re trying to do in the first place!
: Neither do I! That’s why I haven’t succeeded yet!
: Okay, correction — it’s not driving you insane. You are insane. And now, you’re making things even worse for yourself by sneaking off to school in the middle of the night presumably naked.
: I’m not naked this time! I didn’t want to risk getting sexually assaulted by someone who doesn’t excrete an aphrodisiac from their genitals! I don’t have time for that! Or...maybe I do?!
: I have no fucking idea anymore! What even is time?! Because it’s entirely possible we’ve fucking had this conversation already and we’ve just been forced to forget it!
: Nodoka!
: Maggots.
: ...What?!
: Shiori was dead for a full week before they found her. And by the time they did, maggots had already eaten their way into her stomach. Can you ignore that, Otoha?
: I have no fucking clue what you’re talking about right now.
: Because you have never smelt the dead! She was loved! There’s no way they didn’t know! Something- someone rewrote them! The same thing is probably happening to us!
: Nodoka...maybe it’s time to put your mom in a home. Because I’m starting to think that being around her-
: A home for who?...
: Those who are misunderstood?...
: Those who are only called insane because no one believes them?! What they’ve been through?!
: Do I need to be put into a “home” as well then, Otoha?!
: Do I need to suffer because no one else can keep up?! You are supposed to be on my side! You’re supposed to see the world through my eyes! That’s why I share them with you!
: But now you just want to spit on them and roll them through the mud and fucking shit on them, Otoha?! You’re shitting on my eyes! You’re going to make me blind!
: Nodoka-
: No! I’m tired of it! I’m tired of being the only person with a chance to break the mold! I wish nothing more than for the rest of you to be geniuses too! But I guess I’m just fucked, huh?!
: Nodoka!
: I guess this burden is mine to bear just like hers! I guess I have to fix two worlds instead of one! And I guess if I don’t I’m just gonna fuck my teacher forever! Forever! That’s so much fucking!
: Nodoka! Listen to me!

: Don’t get me wrong — he makes me cum harder than any toy and smut combination ever could! But forever?! I will obviously get bored! That’s probably why I’m trying to contact myself in the first place!
: Nodoka!
: Woah, what the fuck?
: What do you mean “what the fuck?” You’re freaking me the hell out. That’s “what the fuck.”
: How...long have you been there exactly?
: I’ve been here the whole fucking time! We came here together! I literally helped you jump the gate!
: Wait, really? Then who was I just talking to on the phone just now?
: No one! Yet you keep on doing it and that is freaking me the fuck out too!
: Listen, I know you brought me here because you have, like...some super genius plan you’re trying to take care of or whatever, but I can’t let you keep doing this.
: I’ve barely even slept lately because you keep fucking waking me up in the middle of the night, dude.
: And I get that you’re against it and everything, but I really think you need to see a shrink or something, Nodoka. This shit’s gone way too far.
: You’re losing yourself, man. And if you keep this up, you’re gonna lose me too.
: I know that’s not what you want. I know you think you’re doing this for me or...us or...whoever you say you’re doing it for. But this isn’t what we want.
: Maybe...time is repeating. Maybe you are right. But none of us know that. So isn’t it better if we all just...stay in the dark?
: Well?
: Holy shit.
: I really am fucking insane, aren’t I?
: Maybe not if you’re actually willing to admit it now...
: But either way, can we go home? Because now I’m just tired and confused and...know what? How about I buy you dinner or some shit on the way back? As...thanks for trying to...save us.
: Anything you want. Just name it.
: I want a whole fucking rotisserie chicken.
: ...Really?
: That’s what-
: And lemonade.
: Two lemonades.
: And JagaRico.
: Sure, Nodoka.
: You can have an entire rotisserie chicken, two lemonades, and some JagaRico.
: You know, maybe we should look into getting you micro-chipped or something? Because if you ran off on your own tonight and I wasn’t here to talk you down, who knows what could have went wrong?
: I’d probably be naked. Or mostly naked. I like being naked when I hear things. And the rest of the time. I wish we were all naked, all the time. That’s the world I really want.
: Well, do you want to know what world I really want? One where my roommate isn’t a fucking lunatic and doesn’t force me to skip out on parties just to watch her talk to herself on a roof.
: I’m...sorry, Otoha. This is...kind of weird for me.
: I’ve never really contemplated the fact that I’ve been actually seeing things before. This is a huge fucking curveball, huh? Why didn’t past me say anything?
: Because “past you” probably doesn’t even exist. This could all be one huge fucking hallucination that-
: Ahem.
: That...
: Ah, crap.
: You...
: You’re...the one she...
: I’m sorry, Nodoka.
: I tried.
: ...What?
[[REDACTED] has left the chat!
: ...What?!
: Ahem!
: Nyaa~
